summary: Baker and colleagues’ Three Bears archive contains strain-specific diet results for adipose, heart, islet, kidney, liver and skeletal muscle. The manuscript documents hypothalamus collection, but the archive omits that tissue, GEO supplies expression and annotation only, and the conference abstract gives no gene-level NZO hypothalamus estimates.

manualReview.summary: Three Bears author diet results cover six other tissues
manualReview.note: The Baker et al. eLife reviewed preprint (10.7554/eLife.108435.1) and bioRxiv preprint (10.1101/2025.02.12.637923) describe hypothalamus collection and cite sibling accessions in GSE235498. The current Churchill Lab Three Bears portal supplies strain-specific diet effects, raw P and adjusted P for six tissues. Its archive omits hypothalamus, and none of the registered ORSAM barcodes appears in its sample manifests. The 2022 GSA abstract 396V describes a hypothalamic response without assigning gene-level effects to the NZO diet contrast. Both deposited GEO expression matrices contain gene identifiers and sample columns only. The separate annotation table and all GSM supplementary fields were checked. All twelve registered libraries map to NZO hypothalamus with matching sex and diet. Source inventory, methods, and local output hashes are in data/author-validation/continued-sources/GSE235479/codex-2026-11-21/SEARCH_LOG.md and audit.json.
reviewFlags: The public author results cover other tissues. Same-tissue effects and inference remain unassessed for hfhs_vs_control.
GEO identifies the hypothalamus libraries by ORSAM and GSM. The authors describe group housing for NZO mice but supply no hypothalamus library-to-mouse or cage assignment in the inspected sources.
The legacy input lacks a committed source-file checksum manifest. This review pins the freshly retrieved GEO source files.

verificationReview.reason: The Three Bears archive contains gene-level NZO diet effects and raw and adjusted P values for six other tissues. The registered target is NZO whole hypothalamus. Its GEO measurements and the conference abstract supply no same-tissue author contrast estimates for pairing.
verificationReview.nextStep: Reopen if the authors release the NZO hypothalamus HFHS-versus-control gene table with its sample list, sex adjustment, effect direction and inference columns.
